content_sections.heading: CURAJ Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the CURAJ Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download CURAJ Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: CURAJ Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available - 1 for Sports Manager (Indoor Sports Complex), 1 for Store In-Charge (Central Stores) and 1 for Consultant (Store).

content_sections.heading: CURAJ Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Sports Manager (Indoor Sports Complex): Master's Degree in Physical Education (M.P.Ed.)/ Sports Management or equivalent from a recognized University with minimum three years experience in management of sports facilities/events and working knowledge of computer applications. Store In-Charge (Central Stores): Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognized University/Institution with desirable 03 years experience in handling stores, inventory management, procurement. Consultant (Store): Retired Government/PSU/University/Autonomous Institution employee having Graduate degree with at least 10 years relevant experience in Stores, Procurement and Inventory Management.

content_sections.heading: CURAJ Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 30 years for all posts. Age relaxation rules will be as per the government norms. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: CURAJ Recruitment 2026 - Salary
content_sections.text: Sports Manager (Indoor Sports Complex): Rs. 47500 per month consolidated Store In-Charge (Central Stores): Rs. 39200 per month consolidated Consultant (Store): Rs. 39200 - 47500 Per Month

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for CURAJ Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.curaj.ac.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 10-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CURAJ Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the CURAJ Recruitment 2026 is 10th October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the authorities before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in CURAJ Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the posts of Sports Manager, Store In-Charge, and Consultant (Store) in the Central University of Rajasthan Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for CURAJ Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for the CURAJ Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Sports Manager post?
faq.answer: For the Sports Manager post, candidates must possess a Master's Degree in Physical Education (M.P.Ed.) or Sports Management, along with at least three years of experience in sports facility management.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the CURAJ posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the advertised posts in the CURAJ Recruitment 2026 is 30 years. Age relaxation will be applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for CURAJ Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for CURAJ Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Store In-Charge post?
faq.answer: The Store In-Charge post offers a consolidated salary of Rs. 39200 per month. The salary for other posts may vary as per the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for CURAJ Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for the CURAJ Recruitment 2026 will be based on an interview. Candidates shortlisted will be called for the interview round.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form for CURAJ Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application form for CURAJ Recruitment 2026 can be downloaded from the official website of the Central University of Rajasthan, www.curaj.ac.in.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant certificates along with the filled application form.
